prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1184; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through the intersection on the main road in League City, heading east. The light had been green for me as I approached.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle came from the cross street on my right side and went through the stop sign. It hit the passenger side of my car. I tried to brake but there was no time.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was. The airbag on my side did deploy.
Q: Did you lose consciousness or hit your head?
A: No. I was dazed for a few seconds, but I stayed conscious and got out of the car on my own.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: My lower back is sore and stiff. It's worse in the morning and when I sit for a long time. I went to urgent care that same afternoon.
Q: Have you received any other treatment since then?
A: I've been doing physical therapy twice a week and taking over-the-counter pain medication. My doctor mentioned a possible muscle strain.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble lifting things at work, and I'd like to know what the next steps are for my medical bills.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you in writing.
A: Okay, thank you.
